description: Implementation of the Device_WiFi_EndPoint class for managing WiFi endpoint parameters, cache refresh, and API interactions within a TR-069 WiFi implementation.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint
classes.description: Represents a WiFi endpoint with methods to get/set parameters, refresh cache, and manage instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint for a given device ID.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint instances.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Updates the cached parameters of the WiFi endpoint by querying system or network APIs.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the Enable status of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Enable
methods.description: Sets the Enable status of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status string of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_ProfileReference
methods.description: Retrieves the profile reference associated with the endpoint.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_ProfileReference
methods.description: Sets the profile reference for the endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_SSIDReference
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID reference associated with the endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_ProfileNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of profile entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Stats_LastDataDownlinkRate
methods.description: Retrieves the last data downlink rate statistic.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Stats_LastDataUplinkRate
methods.description: Retrieves the last data uplink rate statistic.
